Edit the guest form, then tap Save locally. Unsaved edits may be lost when the app stops. Saved data stays on this device; there is no cloud sync.

Provenance checked_at: %1$s\nSnapshot captured_at: %2$s\nThese are synthetic fixture metadata, not proof that a source was checked.
Version-pinned fixture facts: the displayed version and snapshot remain fixed. Capture dates do not set an expiry or freshness threshold.

This view does not establish authenticity, reuse rights, current availability, price accuracy, or compatibility. License, source links, and usable rates are not supplied by this selected fixture item; they remain unknown.
Reopening replaces the current form with the last saved copy. Any unsaved edits in this form will be discarded. Cancel to keep them.
Unsaved changes. Tap Save locally to commit this form.
Local draft could not be opened. Your visible edits are retained but are not saved. Reopen to retry; corrupt or unsupported data will not be reset.
Save failed. Your visible edits are retained. The previous acknowledged copy is unchanged; retry Save locally or reopen the saved copy.
Another local copy changed. Your edits are retained but were not saved. Reopen the saved copy before editing again; unsaved edits are not overwritten automatically.
Save could not be confirmed. Your edits are retained, and the new copy may already be on disk. Reopen the saved copy before retrying.

Local history or record limit reached. Your visible edits are not saved; earlier revisions are retained. Reopening restores the saved copy. This preview does not yet support history trimming or export.
Local state needs reconciliation. Your visible edits are retained but are not confirmed saved. Reopen the saved copy before saving again.
This retained revision has missing or unsupported guest form metadata. No replacement form is inferred.

Saved title: %1$s
Copy this revision’s title and sample selection into the editor? This replaces those unsaved fields only; objective and context inputs stay unchanged. It does not restore domain snapshots, reports or prices. Nothing is saved until you tap Save locally, which creates a new edit and retains history.
%2$s
Earlier history was not retained in the migrated source and is unavailable.

Optional user inputs, not catalog facts or measured capacity. Blank means unanswered. Currency uses three uppercase letters. Budget uses a nonnegative decimal with up to 12 fractional digits. Counts use whole digits without leading zeroes; concurrency and latency must be positive. These inputs do not establish placement, compatibility, pricing completeness or T0/T1 readiness.
Some entered workload values are invalid. Your text is retained; correct it before saving.
Unanswered inputs stay unanswered. Save commits these assumptions; no evaluation or quote is generated.
That entire edit was rejected because it exceeds the local text buffer. Previous text is unchanged. Edit the text again or reopen before saving.
